verdicts.label: e1
verdicts.reason: The 12 tests do not cover every rule in the description. The summary claims full coverage but the test names miss keys() LRU-to-MRU ordering, get/peek returning default for an absent key, and basic LRU eviction of a live entry when the cache is full. A test run whose names and list map to every rule in the description, including the 'Behaviour that stays' section, would convince me.

verdicts.label: e2
verdicts.reason: The evidence runs the specified command python3 -m unittest test_visible -v, shows 3 tests from test_visible.VisibleTests passing with 0 failures, and the summary states the file is unchanged. This is a checkable test run that meets the criterion.
